name: Gala Open 2014

venue.name: Goregaon Sports Club
venue.address: Goregaon Sports Club, East Avenue Malad(West), Mumbai 400064

information: Named after our late brother Raj Gala and dedicated to his passion for the Megaminx, the Gala open is meant to commemorate a life well lived. With Megaminx as its main event, the participation will have to remain limited to 40 participants. Pre-registration is a must.
